summary: Apodex 1.1 Mini (model ID apodex/apodex-1.1-mini) is a 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts text model with a 262,144-token context window, function calling, structured outputs and reasoning, served on Novita's OpenAI-compatible serverless API. Novita's pricing page lists its input and output as Free; the Oct 1 launch blog describes the $0 pricing as a launch promotion that is not permanent and may change.
claim_steps: Create a Novita AI account and an API key in Key Management
